summary: OrientationEditAll is a user control (.NET, ASP.NET WebForms) for managing and editing student orientation records in bulk within an enrollment system. It supports viewing, editing, adding, and saving orientation details for multiple students via a grid interface, with business logic for field validation, workflow navigation, and conditional rendering depending on user session and permissions.
purpose: To allow authorized users to view and update student orientation records, including saving all edits, saving individual edits, and navigating between records. It provides a grid interface for bulk editing, uses business rules for field visibility, validation, and session-based access, and handles server-side and client-side events for robust data management.

workflows.name: Bulk Edit Orientation Records
steps: Bind gridDataEdit with student orientation records using filters and session parameters.
For each row, enable/disable controls depending on blnReadOnly.
Provide field-specific UI (agency, site, content source, location, date, comments, description).
Detect 'dirty' rows (changed data), using hidden fields and client-side JavaScript.
On 'Save All' or 'Save Edit Next', iterate through each row: if dirty, save new or update existing records.
For new records, call controller.Add; for existing, call controller.Update.
Validate fields, restrict comment length (max 1000 characters), and validate date.
Handle navigation: redirect to Enrollment page or next edit screen based on commands.
Handle cancel: redirect to Enrollment page.
Display/hide Save buttons based on read-only mode, number of rows, EnrollmentID, and scroll logic.
Setup client-side JavaScript variables for dynamic field validation.

business_rules: Save buttons and editing fields are only enabled when blnReadOnly is false.
If EnrollmentID != 0, only individual saves are available; otherwise, bulk actions (Save All) are enabled.
ContentSource, OnsiteLocation, Description fields visibility controlled by ProviderTypeCode.
Agency must not be empty for adding/updating records.
Date field validated for proper format; invalid dates signaled to the user.
Dirty rows are only processed for saving.
UserSession must be present to enable data retrieval; otherwise, selection is cancelled.
validations: OrientationDate: Valid date format required; invalid triggers JavaScript warning.
Agency: Must not be empty for save operations.
calculations: providerTypeCodeID: Derived via Codes.CodeSearchID based on UserSession and ProviderTypeCode.
conditions: If blnReadOnly is true: all edit fields and Save buttons disabled.
If EnrollmentID > 0: show only single row editing.
If gridDataEdit.Rows.Count < 14: Hide Save All and Cancel buttons in header.
If ProviderTypeCode contains 'OrientationProviderType_': show Description field, hide ContentSource and OnsiteLocation.
system_behavior: On grid row command (Save All, Save Edit Next, Save): process and persist dirty records.
On Prerender: disable fields if blnReadOnly.
On RowDataBound: toggle visibility of fields/buttons based on EnrollmentID and ProviderTypeCode.
On DataBound: hide buttons if fewer rows than page size.
Setup client-side script variables for fields (e.g., txtDirty, OrientationDateInvalid) for use in JavaScript.
Redirects performed after saves/cancels, with query string parameters set for navigation/context.
dependencies: HSPnetSession (User session for security and filtering)
exceptions: If UserSession is null, cancel all DB selection and grid operations.
If hasMessage is true or UserSession.Messages.GetErrors().Count >= 1, stop redirect post-save.
If agency is empty, skip add/update record.
